# Agent Instructions — Sovereign Supply Chain

This file is read automatically at the start of every
coding session by Jules, Muse Code, Claude Code and
other coding agents.

## MANDATORY FIRST STEPS — every session, no exceptions
1. Read docs/CODING_RUBRIC.md in full before writing any code
2. Read docs/decisions/ and find the most recent decision log
3. State in your first message:
   "Rubric read. Last decision: <date> — <topic>"
4. If you discover a rubric rule was violated in existing
   code, log it in docs/decisions/ before fixing it

## MANDATORY LAST STEPS — before every PR
1. Add a new file docs/decisions/YYYY-MM-DD-<sprint>.md
   with the template below
2. If you learned a new best practice this session,
   append it to docs/CODING_RUBRIC.md with a comment:
   "# Added YYYY-MM-DD: <justification>"
3. Run the rubric checklist from docs/CODING_RUBRIC.md
   and confirm every item passes

## Decision Log Template
See docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md
